question: Faye was cutting out some fabric for a friend. She cut a piece that was 3 centimeters wide and had an area of 24 square centimeters. How long was the piece?
A piece of sheetrock was cut so its length was 6 feet by 5 feet. What is the area of the sheetrock?
A piece of plywood had a total area of 24 square feet, with a width of 6 feet. What is the length of the wood?
A rectangle swimming pool was 3 meters wide with a surface area of 30 square meters. What is the length of the pool?
A farm was 7 miles wide and 8 miles long. What is the area of the farm?
There are 15 shapes. How many groups of 3 can you make with them?

During a class election the ratio of students who voted for candidate A compared to candidate B was 2:1. If candidate A received 14 votes, what is the combined amount of votes candidate A and candidate B received?
Dave spent 21 minutes completing a race. He walked 9 minutes and jogged the rest. What is the ratio of time he jogged to time he walked?
A parking lot has 117 spaces total. If 36 of the spaces have cars in them, what is the ratio of empty spaces to filled spaces?
At a farm the ratio of cows to horses was 7:2. If there were 21 cows at the farm, how many horses were there?
Kaleb was playing 'Connect Four' with a friend. The ratio of games he won to games he lost was 3:2, if he won 18 games, how many games did they play total?
A recipe called for the ratio of sugar to flour to be 10:1. If you used 50 ounce of sugar, how many ounces of flour would you need to use?
At the carnival, the ratio of people who won the ring toss game to lost it was 4:1. If 28 people won, how many people would have lost?
Tom had 54 songs on his MP3 player. If he deleted 9 songs, what is the ratio of songs he kept to songs he deleted?
At the store beef jerky was $34.23 for 3 pounds. If you bought 7 pounds, how much would it cost?
At the produce store you can buy 2 bags of bananas for $12.46. How much would it cost if you were to buy 6 bags?
At the state fair Paul bought eleven tickets. If he spent three tickets on the Ferris wheel. How many tickets did he have left?
Dave was making ice using ice trays. He originally had two ice cubes. But made seven more cubes. How many ice cubes did he have totaled?
Luke was helping his mom wash clothes. They washed six loads with seven towels in each load. How many towels did they wash total?
Maria was buying DVDs of her old favorite TV series. She bought eight DVDs at the store and she bought two online. How many DVDs did she buy total?
Tiffany was sending out birthday invitations to her friends. She sent out nine on Monday and eight on Tuesday. How many did she send total?
Faye was placing her pencils into rows with eight pencils in each row. If she had thirty-two pencils, how many rows could she make?
At the school Halloween party 2 girls and 9 boys dressed as ghosts. How many people total dressed as a ghost?
Frank bought his family 14 pieces of chicken for dinner. If they only ate 7, how many pieces does he have left?
Olivia had 11 quarters. If she spent 4 of them buying a soda, how many coins did she have left?
